questionText:
Consider the unsigned 8-bit fixed point binary number representation below,

$$b_7 b_6 b_5 b_4 b_3 . b_2 b_1 b_0$$

where the position of the binary point is between $b_3$ and $b_2$. Assume $b_7$ is the most significant bit. Some of the decimal numbers listed below cannot be represented exactly in the above representation:
(i) $31.500$
(ii) $0.875$
(iii) $12.100$
(iv) $3.001$

Which one of the following statements is true?
options: None of (i), (ii), (iii), (iv) can be exactly represented
Only (iii) and (iv) cannot be exactly represented
Only (i) and (ii) cannot be exactly represented
explanation:
In the given 8-bit representation $b_7 b_6 b_5 b_4 b_3 . b_2 b_1 b_0$:
• The integer part uses 5 bits ($b_7$ to $b_3$), which can represent integers up to $2^5 - 1 = 31$.
• The fractional part uses 3 bits ($b_2, b_1, b_0$), where the resolution is $2^{-3} = 0.125$. Thus, a fractional part must be an exact multiple of $0.125$ to be represented.

Evaluating each number:
(i) 31.500: Integer $31 \le 31$ and fraction $0.500 = 4 \times 0.125$. Can be represented exactly ($11111.100_2$).
(ii) 0.875: Integer $0 \le 31$ and fraction $0.875 = 7 \times 0.125$. Can be represented exactly ($00000.111_2$).
(iii) 12.100: The fractional part $0.100$ is not a multiple of $0.125$, so it cannot be represented exactly.
(iv) 3.001: The fractional part $0.001$ is not a multiple of $0.125$, so it cannot be represented exactly.

Therefore, only (iii) and (iv) cannot be exactly represented.
